title: Unplanned Grex outage - restarting login nodes and OOD
body:
Unplanned reboot of login nodes and OOD server

Yak and OOD are availanle to users. The alternate login node, bison, is being worked on.

Unplanned reboot of login nodes and OOD server

We are performing a restart of login nodes of Grex, and OOD web portal. Thus access to the system will be temporarily unavailable, for about an hour (5:10 PM to 6:00 PM). Running jobs and data/storage will not be affected. Thank you for your patience!
